facts.business: Autoline Industries Limited is an integrated design, engineering and manufacturing automotive component platform producing sheet metal components and assemblies, exhaust systems, pedal systems, door assemblies, load bodies, hinges, skin panels and other value-added automotive structures for passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and electric vehicles.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex (Property, Plant and Equipment + Intangible Assets + Capital Work-in-Progress + Right-of-Use Assets)

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Agreement executed 5th May 2025; advance paid March 2025

auditor.name: KANJ & CO. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to MAT Credit of Rs 596.80 Lakhs carried forward unlikely to be utilized within designated period, overstating MAT Credit Asset, comprehensive income & retained earnings. Emphasis of matter on contingent liability of Rs 530.88 Lakhs (net) regarding US court judgment against CJ Holdings North America, LLC.

key_risks: Contingent liability from US court judgment (CJ Holdings North America, LLC)
Going concern assessment dependent on management forecasts and promoter financial support
Uncertain tax positions and litigations with direct/indirect tax authorities
Delay in regulatory filings (SEBI LODR, FEMA) leading to fines
Customer concentration risk (Mahindra & Mahindra doubling of business)
Foreign exchange risk on overseas subsidiary (Koderat Investments Limited, Cyprus)
facts.related_party_note: Advances to suppliers of related parties: Rs 6.05 Lakhs (FY 2025); Loans to AIPL: Rs 215.52 Lakhs (FY 2026); CSR expenditure includes contribution to trust controlled by company (details not specified).
